examinerLines.rationale: Sound-check line before the mock exam (UX-OQ-10). Wording proposed by danish-language-reviewer in the pilot review (2026-11-20).

text.da: Nu vil jeg stille dig et spørgsmål af en mere overordnet karakter.

examinerLines.rationale: SIRI's 2024 examiner booklet (pp. 7, 9, 11) gives only a stage direction: 'Eksaminator informerer om, at der nu stilles et spørgsmål af en mere overordnet karakter.' Wording proposed by pd3-exam-expert in the exam-accuracy review of the PRD (DL-050). The 2019 booklet has no transition at all.
The examiner says 'tak', not 'fint' (ABOUT_PD3_MUNDTLIG.md §4.1), and never 'godt' (DL-021).

intros.rationale: DL-045: for terms without a public SIRI examiner booklet (2016–2023; searched 2026-11-21), one sentence per situation, written from the booklet's own situation title in the style of SIRI's 2024 'Forslag til indledning'. Nothing beyond the title is added; where a title is ambiguous, the wording was checked against the situation's question so the two don't contradict each other. Needs danish-language-reviewer (language) and pd3-exam-expert (fit with the question). Revised 2026-11-21 after the Danish review of the intros and the exam review of intros and 2019 (reconciled table wins): 32 changed, 64 kept. Writing rule: docs/content/pipeline.md.

spokenOverrides.rationale: Exam review 2026-11-20 (S2): the examiner voice says both halves, never only 'Hvorfor?'. Play the text before the ending (verbatim), pause, then the override. The displayed text stays as printed. Wording 'Hvorfor eller hvorfor ikke?' (no comma) from pd3-exam-expert.
